review_findings.defect: Adding the matching primary product to an otherwise conflicting current asset/ticket record could conceal the conflict.
review_findings.correction: Compare primary and secondary scope separately; compatible extra or omitted secondary qualifiers do not conceal conflicting current values. Explicitly foreign primary products remain excluded.

review_findings.defect: A draft or otherwise non-current record could incorrectly veto a selected current firmware answer.
review_findings.correction: Apply the existing current-authority predicate consistently when evaluating other records as conflicts.

scope: Software, parser, retrieval and scripted-selection regression testing. This does not estimate hidden-grader accuracy or establish fresh neural execution.
